The headline restricted-oracle theorem has an evaluable full-class certificate, but its positioning is incomplete: the bibliography entries for Mou et al., Cussens et al., and Sverdrup et al. receive no relevance sentence or theorem-level distinction in the related-work account; add targeted comparisons explaining why none supplies this risk oracle or its restricted-circuit certificate.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery produced 14 informally proved nodes and seven verified-attested cited leaves, including legal exact-margin approximation and a restricted histogram-affine adverse-risk oracle. Independent MAIN validity confirmed incremental novelty below the fixed field floor: the affine domain cannot achieve vanishing regret, and nonlinear cellwise multinomial risk certification is a material new program. The unrestricted oracle remains open and the related-work comparison finding remains unrepaired; no F-stage or Lean certification was performed.
tldr: Valid comparison-free histogram-affine learner circuits admit a full-class worst-case causal-regret certificate with a legal algebraic adverse state and rational risk endpoints of any prescribed width. The box-free oracle enumerates neither sample histograms nor legal mesh-value boxes. Its exact-margin search preserves the whole defined \(\mathcal C_G\); affine stability and winner-envelope approximation prove that transfer internally. An optimized tolerance allocation and the published block-sensitive quantifier-elimination bound give an explicit arithmetic count, including witness sampling. The remaining question concerns unrestricted branching or nonlinear circuits and practical complexity. The experiment retains \(B_{01,n}=B_{02,n}\le B_{12,n}\le M_n\), its finite-game LP certificate, the exact \(47/384\) finite-family fixture, and the saturated-wave obstruction to shallow scalar trees. The matched \(n^{-2/5}\) rate and boundary-tail localization are credited benchmark infrastructure, not the novelty claim.
gap: Generic minimax algorithms assume adverse-risk optimization. Smooth policy-value envelopes optimize a different objective. The exact-margin class couples the means determining training probabilities with the means determining deployment regret.
fill: The affine-circuit theorem computes exact finite-net risks from first moments, validates the procedure on the fixed-total histogram domain, and transfers the maximizing legal state to a full-class risk bracket. It proves removal of histogram enumeration. The exact-margin legal-net primitive retains its construction, preparation, and enumeration costs; removing these together with histogram enumeration is the unrestricted open oracle target.
